caption: The drawing depicts a rounded, jug-like ceramic vessel with a broad body, a curved handle that arches over the top, and a short, wide-necked spout near the handle’s base. The main color of the vessel is a light grayish-beige with patches of brownish discoloration. On the vessel’s side, just below the spout, there is a decorative element in blue, featuring a curling botanical design and the number “1.” The spout has a thick, raised rim, and some blue glazing surrounds its base. In the upper left corner, a smaller inset illustration shows the same vessel from a different angle, highlighting its curved handle and the mouth with a partial stopper in the spout. The drawing is set against a plain background with a faint rectangular border, and in the lower right corner, the artist’s name, "Yolande Delasser," is written.
title: Harvester Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
